intro: Checks the public GamerPower giveaway feed and can direct viewers to the Discord list. Twitch and Kick use rewards; YouTube and TikTok use one command.

sections.title: 1. Viewer access
sections.notice: Create one Free Games reward on Twitch and Kick, then paste each stable reward ID. Create the no-response command only for YouTube and TikTok through Command Sync. Existing platform intake actions receive all four paths.

sections.title: 2. Send viewers to Discord
sections.notice: When a matching reward or command arrives, StreamBridge replies only in that source chat. The cooldown prevents command spam. Use {name} and {discord} in the editable message.

sections.title: 3. Post the free-game list to Discord
sections.notice: Import and approve Discord Deliver only when this is enabled. Keep the private webhook in Streamer.bot; never paste it into the wizard.

sections.title: 4. Automatic announcements
sections.notice: Automatic full game links in chat remain optional. The first scan is silent by default so installing the add-on cannot flood chat or Discord.
